solo.hintKlondikeSelected: A card is selected. Tap a destination column, or tap again to cancel.
solo.hintKlondikeIdle: Tap a card → tries to send to foundation. Tap again → move mode.
solo.hintSpiderIdle: Tap a card or the bottom of a run to select it.
solo.hintFreeCellSelected: Tap a destination (column, free cell, or foundation)
solo.hintFreeCellIdle: Tap a card to select it.
solo.hintYukonIdle: Tap a face-up card. Yukon: you can move any group.
solo.hintGolfIdle: Tap the top card of a column whose value is ±1 from the waste card.
solo.hintPyramid: Pair 2 cards summing to 13. The King (13) is removed alone. A=1, J=11, Q=12, K=13.
solo.hintTriPeaks: Tap a card ±1 from the waste. A↔K (circular). Not drawing = combo doubles the score.
solo.hintFortyThieves: Descending SAME suit. 1 card at a time. Tap = try foundation, otherwise select to move.
solo.hintAccordion: Tap a card then tap one 1 or 3 spaces left (same value OR same suit). Reduce all to 1 single pile.

ai.tutorialBody: AI plays the optimal solution automatically. The blue badge shows the next move before it's played. Cycle speed with the counter (0.5× to Turbo).

solo.noHintBody: No legal move found. Restart or draw.

stuck.title: Game stuck
stuck.body: No legal move is possible anymore. You can restart for a new deal, keep exploring the board, or quit.

solo.hintDrawBody: No real move possible with visible cards. Tap the stock to reveal new cards — your hint is preserved.
solo.hintDealBody: No move possible. Tap the stock to deal a row — your hint is preserved.

impossible.title: Game impossible
impossible.body: You've gone through the stock 2 times without making progress. This deal has no solution. Start a new game for a better deal!

klondike-1.name: Klondike (Draw 1)
klondike-1.shortDesc: Classic Solitaire — draw 1 card at a time.

rules.title: Goal
rules.body: Place all 52 cards onto the 4 foundations, organized by suit, from Ace → King.

rules.title: Setup
rules.body: 7 columns on the tableau (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 cards). Only the bottom card of each column is face-up. The remaining 24 cards form the stock.

rules.title: On the tableau
rules.body: Descending sequence (King → Ace) with alternating colors: red on black, black on red. Example: 9 on 10.

rules.title: On the foundations
rules.body: Ascending Ace → King, same suit ( on , etc.).

rules.title: Empty column
rules.body: Only a King may occupy an empty column.

rules.title: Move a sequence
rules.body: You may move an entire face-up sequence if it follows the rule (descending + alternating colors).

rules.title: Stock
rules.body: Tap the stock → 1 card to the waste. When the stock is empty, it recycles from the waste (unlimited).

rules.title: Win
rules.body: All 4 foundations complete (52 cards placed).

klondike-3.name: Klondike (Draw 3)
klondike-3.shortDesc: Harder variant — draw 3 cards but only the 3rd is playable.

rules.title: Goal
rules.body: Same as Klondike Draw 1 — place all 52 cards on the 4 foundations.

rules.title: Difference
rules.body: Tap the stock → 3 cards revealed at once. Only the 3rd is immediately playable.

rules.title: Strategy
rules.body: Anticipate which triplets will appear. Harder than Draw 1 since only 1/3 of cards are directly accessible.

rules.title: Re-deal
rules.body: Unlimited (Standard variant).

klondike-vegas.name: Klondike Vegas
klondike-vegas.shortDesc: Initial $52 stake. +$5 per card on foundations. Max 3 passes.

rules.title: Initial stake
rules.body: $52 wagered at start ($1 per card).

rules.title: Score
rules.body: +$5 per card placed on foundations. Goal: finish above $52 to win.

rules.title: Stock
rules.body: 3 cards per draw. Maximum 3 passes — after that, you can't draw anymore.

rules.title: Target
rules.body: Place at least 11 cards on foundations to break even.

spider-1.name: Spider 1 suit
spider-1.shortDesc: Easy variant — 104 cards but a single suit ().

rules.title: Goal
rules.body: Build 8 complete King → Ace runs of the same suit. Each run is auto-removed.

rules.title: Setup
rules.body: 10 columns on the tableau (4 columns of 6, 6 columns of 5). Only the last card of each column is visible. 50 remaining cards in the stock (5 deals of 10).

rules.title: Tableau
rules.body: Descending (King → Ace). Any suit may stack on top, BUT you can only move a run if it's all the same suit.

rules.title: Stock
rules.body: Tap stock → deals 1 card on each of the 10 columns. You CANNOT deal if any column is empty.

rules.title: Win
rules.body: 8 King → Ace runs removed from the tableau.

rules.title: Setup
rules.body: Like Spider 1 suit, but with AND .

rules.title: Added difficulty
rules.body: Suits alternate randomly. Harder to form pure runs to move.

rules.title: Setup
rules.body: 2 full decks of 52 cards ( × 2).

rules.title: The challenge
rules.body: You must isolate each suit to move them as a block. For experts only.

freecell.name: FreeCell
freecell.shortDesc: 99.999% of deals are solvable — pure thinking.

rules.title: Goal
rules.body: Place all 52 cards on the 4 foundations (Ace → King by suit).

rules.title: Setup
rules.body: 8 columns (4 of 7 cards, 4 of 6 cards). All cards face-up from the start. 4 free cells + 4 empty foundations.

rules.title: Free cells
rules.body: Each one holds a single card (any), like a temporary parking spot.

rules.title: Tableau
rules.body: Descending + alternating colors (red on black, black on red). An empty column accepts any card.

rules.title: Multi-card moves
rules.body: Officially 1 card at a time. In practice, you can move (free cells + 1) × 2^(empty columns) cards in one move.

rules.title: Strategy
rules.body: Always keep at least 1 free cell and 1 empty column in reserve. Spot Aces and 2s buried under high cards.

rules.title: Goal
rules.body: Empty the entire pyramid (28 cards) by removing pairs of cards summing to 13.

rules.title: Setup
rules.body: 7 rows in pyramid (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 cards). A card is usable only if no card overlaps it from below.

rules.title: Values
rules.body: Ace = 1, 2-10 = face value, Jack = 11, Queen = 12, King = 13.

rules.title: Stock
rules.body: Tap the stock to reveal a card on the waste. You may pair a pyramid card with the waste.

rules.title: Win
rules.body: Whole pyramid removed. The more cards you remove, the higher your score.

rules.title: Goal
rules.body: Empty all 3 peaks — 28 tableau cards.

rules.title: Setup
rules.body: 3 peaks sharing a bottom row. Only the bottom row is face-up at start.

rules.title: Rule
rules.body: You may remove a face-up card if its value is ±1 from the waste card. Suit doesn't matter.

rules.title: Circular
rules.body: Ace ↔ King: an Ace can follow a King and vice versa.

rules.title: Combos
rules.body: Each chained card without drawing doubles the score: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32 points… Tapping the stock resets the combo.

rules.title: Stock
rules.body: No re-deal: 23 cards max in the stock.

yukon.name: Yukon
yukon.shortDesc: Klondike with no stock — all cards on tableau.

rules.title: Setup
rules.body: 7 columns: 1 card / 6 / 7 / 8 / 9 / 10 / 11. No stock, all 52 cards are dealt onto the tableau.

rules.title: Tableau
rules.body: Descending sequence with alternating colors (red on black, black on red).

rules.title: Unique flexibility
rules.body: You may move ANY face-up card with ALL the cards below it, even if they don't form a valid run.

rules.title: Empty column
rules.body: Only a King (with whatever follows) may occupy an empty column.

rules.title: Foundations
rules.body: Ace → King by suit ( ).

rules.title: Win
rules.body: All 4 foundations complete (52 cards).

rules.title: Goal
rules.body: Empty the tableau. Like in golf, your score = remaining cards: MINIMUM = better.

rules.title: Setup
rules.body: 7 columns of 5 cards face-up (35 cards). 17 cards in stock, 1 card on waste.

rules.title: Rule
rules.body: Place a card from the top of a column onto the waste if its value is ±1 from the waste card. Suit irrelevant.

rules.title: Terminal King
rules.body: The King (13) is terminal: nothing chains after. You must draw.

rules.title: Stock
rules.body: Tap the stock → 1 card to waste. No re-deal.

rules.title: Win
rules.body: Tableau fully cleared.

forty-thieves.name: Forty Thieves
forty-thieves.shortDesc: Very hard — 2 decks, 1 card at a time.

rules.title: Setup
rules.body: 2 full decks. 10 columns of 4 cards (all visible). 64 cards in stock. 8 empty foundations.

rules.title: Tableau
rules.body: Descending SAME SUIT ( on , on ). NO alternation.

rules.title: 1 card at a time
rules.body: You may only move ONE card at a time (the last of a column or the waste).

rules.title: Empty column
rules.body: Any card may occupy an empty column.

rules.title: Stock
rules.body: Tap the stock → 1 card to waste. No re-deal.

rules.title: Foundations
rules.body: 8 foundations (2 per suit). Ace → King by suit. Win = all complete (104 cards).

accordion.name: Accordion
accordion.shortDesc: Reduce 52 cards to a single pile.

rules.title: Setup
rules.body: 52 cards laid in a row, all face-up.

rules.title: Rule
rules.body: Place a card on its immediate left neighbor (1 space) or on the 3rd card to its left, if SAME VALUE OR SAME SUIT.

rules.title: Stacking
rules.body: The moved card lands on top of the target pile. Cards to the right shift left to fill the gap.

rules.title: Strategy
rules.body: Don't rush: a wrong stack can permanently lock the game. Think several moves ahead.

rules.title: Win
rules.body: Reduce all 52 cards to ONE single pile. Very rare (~0.3% of deals), it's a patience challenge.
